description: Add a piece to a cart. Pass cart_id to reuse an existing cart (the durable handle), or omit it to start a fresh one. Call get_product first to get valid sizes/colours (or an exact variant_id); for a design sold in two fits (regular / oversize, priced apart) you MUST pass `fit`. qty is capped at 20. Returns the cart_id and the server-side cart summary (VAT included where applicable). `region` (ISO-2) sets the currency for a NEW cart only — a reused cart keeps its original region.

cart_id.description: reuse this cart; omit to create a new one

colour.description: piece colour from get_product, e.g. black / white / khaki (khaki: US oversize only; default: the first colour you can buy)

fit.description: regular or oversize; REQUIRED when the design comes in both (get_product lists them)

handle.description: product handle (resolves a variant by size + colour; call get_product for valid values)

region.description: ISO-2 ship-to country for a NEW cart (e.g. se / us / de); ignored when reusing a cart_id

size.description: size label from get_product (Regular S / M / L / XL / 2XL; Oversize XS … 3XL)

variant_id.description: a specific variant id from get_product (overrides handle/size/colour)

name: add_to_cart
